# chessground 9.2.1 (Lichess's board)

Copied unchanged on 28 Nov 2026 from the npm package `chessground@9.2.1` (via unpkg.com), the official build of
https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground. Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (`LICENSE`). Approved by the owner on 28 Nov
for the analysis board. Files: `chessground.min.js` (the board, an ES module, 30 KB), `chessground.base.css` (layout),
`chessground.cburnett.css` (the cburnett pieces, the same set the PC app uses).
To update: download the same three files of a newer version, read the changelog, run `node tests/mobile/rules_test.js`
and try the board on a phone.
